datasets.name: v_dates
datasets.displayName: As-of dates
queryLines: SELECT DISTINCT CAST(as_of_date AS STRING) AS as_of FROM reg_2052a.submission_files ORDER BY 1 DESC

datasets.name: v_entities
datasets.displayName: Reporting entities
queryLines: SELECT entity_id AS entity FROM reference.ref_reporting_entity ORDER BY 1

datasets.name: v_feeds
datasets.displayName: Source feeds
queryLines: SELECT feed FROM VALUES ('deposits'), ('loans'), ('securities'), ('derivatives'), ('funding'), ('finance') AS t(feed)

datasets.name: l_counts
datasets.displayName: Source to report - counts per step
queryLines:
WITH b AS (SELECT record_id FROM conformed.v_source_files WHERE as_of_date = CAST(:as_of AS DATE) AND feed = :feed),
s AS (SELECT record_id FROM conformed.source_position WHERE as_of_date = CAST(:as_of AS DATE) AND source_feed = :feed),
f AS (SELECT p.position_id FROM conformed.fact_liquidity_position p JOIN s USING (record_id) WHERE p.as_of_date = CAST(:as_of AS DATE)),
e AS (SELECT e.position_id FROM conformed.entity_position e JOIN f USING (position_id) WHERE e.as_of_date = CAST(:as_of AS DATE)),
g AS (SELECT DISTINCT l.record_key FROM reg_2052a.record_lineage l JOIN f USING (position_id) WHERE l.as_of_date = CAST(:as_of AS DATE))
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM b) AS bronze_records, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM s) AS dq_passed,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dq.quarantine WHERE as_of_date = CAST(:as_of AS DATE) AND source_feed = :feed) AS quarantined,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM f) AS silver_positions, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM e) AS entity_positions, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM g) AS filed_records

datasets.name: l_bronze
datasets.displayName: Source to report - 1 source records as received
queryLines:
SELECT * EXCEPT (internal_rating, as_of_date) FROM (
  SELECT 'deposits' AS feed, * FROM raw.deposits UNION ALL SELECT 'loans', * FROM raw.loans
  UNION ALL SELECT 'securities', * FROM raw.securities UNION ALL SELECT 'derivatives', * FROM raw.derivatives
  UNION ALL SELECT 'funding', * FROM raw.funding UNION ALL SELECT 'finance', * FROM raw.finance)
WHERE as_of_date = CAST(:as_of AS DATE) AND feed = :feed ORDER BY record_id

datasets.name: l_dq
datasets.displayName: Source to report - 2 data quality check
queryLines:
WITH r AS (SELECT record_id, ARRAY_JOIN(ARRAY_SORT(COLLECT_SET(rule_id)), ', ') AS rules_failed FROM dq.rule_failures
           WHERE as_of_date = CAST(:as_of AS DATE) AND source_feed = :feed GROUP BY 1)
SELECT b.record_id, CASE WHEN q.record_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'QUARANTINED' ELSE 'PASSED' END AS dq_result,
       COALESCE(q.failed_rules, r.rules_failed) AS rules_failed, b.landing_file, b.ingested_at,
       s.source_product_code, s.customer_id, s.currency, s.principal_amount, s.market_value, s.dq_timestamp
FROM conformed.v_source_files b
LEFT JOIN conformed.source_position s ON s.as_of_date = b.as_of_date AND s.record_id = b.record_id
LEFT JOIN dq.quarantine q ON q.as_of_date = b.as_of_date AND q.record_id = b.record_id
LEFT JOIN r ON r.record_id = b.record_id
WHERE b.as_of_date = CAST(:as_of AS DATE) AND b.feed = :feed ORDER BY dq_result DESC, b.record_id

datasets.name: l_silver
datasets.displayName: Source to report - 3 enriched positions
queryLines:
SELECT p.record_id, p.position_id, p.part, p.booking_entity, p.source_product_code, p.standard_product_type, p.pid_rule_id, p.product_id,
       p.table_code, p.customer_id, p.counterparty, p.counterparty_category, p.gsib, p.collateral_class, p.collateral_basis,
       p.maturity_date, p.maturity_basis, p.maturity_bucket, p.insured, p.insured_basis, p.currency,
       COALESCE(p.principal_amount, p.market_value) AS amount, p.lendable_value, p.lendable_basis, p.risk_weight, p.business_line
FROM conformed.fact_liquidity_position p
JOIN conformed.source_position s ON s.as_of_date = p.as_of_date AND s.record_id = p.record_id
WHERE p.as_of_date = CAST(:as_of AS DATE) AND s.source_feed = :feed ORDER BY p.position_id

datasets.name: l_entity
datasets.displayName: Source to report - 4 positions by reporting entity
queryLines:
SELECT e.reporting_entity, e.position_id, e.relationship, e.internal, e.internal_counterparty, p.product_id, COALESCE(p.principal_amount, p.market_value) AS amount
FROM conformed.entity_position e
JOIN conformed.fact_liquidity_position p ON p.as_of_date = e.as_of_date AND p.position_id = e.position_id
JOIN conformed.source_position s ON s.as_of_date = p.as_of_date AND s.record_id = p.record_id
WHERE e.as_of_date = CAST(:as_of AS DATE) AND s.source_feed = :feed ORDER BY e.position_id, e.reporting_entity

datasets.name: l_gold
datasets.displayName: Source to report - 5 reported FR 2052a records
queryLines:
WITH pos AS (SELECT l.record_key, COUNT(*) AS positions_from_feed, SUM(l.amount) AS amount_from_feed
             FROM reg_2052a.record_lineage l
             JOIN conformed.fact_liquidity_position p ON p.as_of_date = l.as_of_date AND p.position_id = l.position_id
             JOIN conformed.source_position s ON s.as_of_date = p.as_of_date AND s.record_id = p.record_id
             WHERE l.as_of_date = CAST(:as_of AS DATE) AND s.source_feed = :feed GROUP BY 1)
SELECT v.reporting_entity, v.table_code, v.product_id, v.counterparty, v.collateral_class, v.maturity_bucket, v.currency, v.converted,
       v.reported_amount, v.record_count AS positions_in_record, pos.positions_from_feed, pos.amount_from_feed, v.record_key
FROM pos JOIN reg_2052a.v_filing_records v ON v.as_of_date = CAST(:as_of AS DATE) AND v.record_key = pos.record_key
ORDER BY v.reporting_entity, v.table_code, v.product_id

datasets.name: c_kpi
datasets.displayName: Data - completeness and accuracy of the day
queryLines:
SELECT (SELECT COUNT_IF(status = 'PASS') FROM dq.feed_monitor WHERE as_of_date = CAST(:as_of AS DATE)) AS feeds_complete,
       (SELECT SUM(records) / SUM(expected_records) FROM dq.feed_monitor WHERE as_of_date = CAST(:as_of AS DATE)) AS volume_vs_expected,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dq.quarantine WHERE as_of_date = CAST(:as_of AS DATE)) AS records_rejected,
       (SELECT COUNT_IF(status <> 'PASS') FROM audit.gl_reconciliation WHERE as_of_date = CAST(:as_of AS DATE))
       + (SELECT COUNT_IF(status <> 'PASS') FROM audit.cross_metric_recon WHERE as_of_date = CAST(:as_of AS DATE)) AS recon_breaks

datasets.name: c_feeds
datasets.displayName: Data - records received vs expected, per source feed
queryLines:
SELECT feed, measure, n AS records FROM dq.feed_monitor
LATERAL VIEW STACK(2, 'Received', CAST(records AS DOUBLE), 'Expected (5-day median)', CAST(expected_records AS DOUBLE)) s AS measure, n
WHERE as_of_date = CAST(:as_of AS DATE) ORDER BY feed

datasets.name: c_issues
datasets.displayName: Data - issues to act on
queryLines:
SELECT 'Completeness' AS dimension, 'Source feed incomplete' AS issue, feed AS item, details AS detail, 'Chase the source system, then re-run' AS action
FROM dq.feed_monitor WHERE as_of_date = CAST(:as_of AS DATE) AND status <> 'PASS'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Accuracy', 'Record rejected by a data quality rule', q.record_id, CONCAT(q.source_feed, ': ', q.failed_rules),
       COALESCE(CONCAT('Fixed in the app: ', x.fix), 'Fix, map or exclude it in step 2 Data quality')
FROM dq.quarantine q
LEFT JOIN (SELECT as_of_date, record_id, MAX_BY(CONCAT(field, ' -> ', new_value, ' (', status, ')'), created_at) AS fix FROM dq.record_fixes
           WHERE status <> 'WITHDRAWN' GROUP BY 1, 2) x ON x.as_of_date = q.as_of_date AND x.record_id = q.record_id
WHERE q.as_of_date = CAST(:as_of AS DATE)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Accuracy', 'General ledger does not tie', recon_type, CONCAT('GL ', ROUND(gl_total, 1), ' vs filing ', ROUND(pipeline_total, 1), ' USD mm (', difference_pct, '%)'),
       'Explain or fix it in step 4 Validate (RECON-GL)'
FROM audit.gl_reconciliation WHERE as_of_date = CAST(:as_of AS DATE) AND status <> 'PASS'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Accuracy', 'FR 2052a does not tie to the LCR', CONCAT(entity_id, ' ', metric_name), CONCAT('LCR ', reg_lcr_value, ' vs filing ', reg_2052a_value),
       'Blocks the filing - investigate'
FROM audit.cross_metric_recon WHERE as_of_date = CAST(:as_of AS DATE) AND status <> 'PASS'

datasets.name: r_kpi
datasets.displayName: Rules - coverage of the day
queryLines:
SELECT s.derived / (s.positions + COALESCE(h.n, 0)) AS classified_pct, COALESCE(h.n, 0) AS without_rule, COALESCE(h.usd, 0) * 1e6 AS without_rule_usd,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_assist.suggestions WHERE status = 'PROPOSED' AND suggestion_type IN ('CUSTOMER_CLASSIFICATION', 'PRODUCT_MAPPING')
          AND as_of_date <= CAST(:as_of AS DATE)
          AND subject_key NOT IN (SELECT customer_id FROM reference.customer_master_approvals)
          AND subject_key NOT IN (SELECT source_product_code FROM reference.source_product_map_approvals)) AS awaiting_master_data
FROM audit.pid_derivation_summary s
LEFT JOIN (SELECT as_of_date, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(amount_usd) AS usd FROM dq.pid_exceptions GROUP BY 1) h USING (as_of_date)
WHERE s.as_of_date = CAST(:as_of AS DATE)

datasets.name: r_by_table
datasets.displayName: Rules - positions classified by a rule vs without one, per FR 2052a table
queryLines:
SELECT table_code, 'Classified by a PID rule' AS outcome, COUNT(*) AS positions FROM conformed.fact_liquidity_position WHERE as_of_date = CAST(:as_of AS DATE) GROUP BY 1, 2
UNION ALL
SELECT COALESCE(REGEXP_EXTRACT(provisional_product_id, '^([A-Z]+\\.[A-Z]+)', 1), 'unknown'), 'No rule / missing master data', COUNT(*)
FROM dq.pid_exceptions WHERE as_of_date = CAST(:as_of AS DATE) GROUP BY 1, 2

datasets.name: r_gaps
datasets.displayName: Rules - records without a rule, and what is missing
queryLines:
SELECT e.record_id AS item, CASE e.exception_type WHEN 'CUSTOMER_PENDING' THEN 'Customer not classified yet' WHEN 'NO_RULE' THEN 'No PID rule matches'
       ELSE e.exception_type END AS gap, e.source_system, e.source_product_code, e.customer_id, e.provisional_product_id, e.amount_usd, e.reason,
       CASE WHEN e.exception_type = 'CUSTOMER_PENDING' AND a.approved_on IS NOT NULL
              THEN CONCAT('Approved from ', a.approved_on, ' - re-run this day to include it, or leave it out')
            WHEN e.exception_type = 'CUSTOMER_PENDING' THEN 'Approve the customer in step 3 PID enrichment' ELSE 'Add or extend a PID rule' END AS action
FROM dq.pid_exceptions e LEFT JOIN reference.customer_master_approvals a ON a.customer_id = e.customer_id
WHERE e.as_of_date = CAST(:as_of AS DATE)
UNION ALL
SELECT q.record_id, 'Bank product code not in the catalogue', get_json_object(q.record_json, '$.source_system'), q.source_product_code,
       get_json_object(q.record_json, '$.customer_id'), NULL, NULL, 'New product code - the record cannot be classified',
       CASE WHEN m.source_product_code IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT('Mapped to ', m.standard_product_type, ' - re-run to classify') ELSE 'Map the code in step 2 Data quality' END
FROM dq.quarantine q LEFT JOIN reference.source_product_map_approvals m ON m.source_product_code = q.source_product_code
WHERE q.as_of_date = CAST(:as_of AS DATE) AND q.failed_rules LIKE '%DQ_006%'
UNION ALL
SELECT s.subject_key, CASE s.suggestion_type WHEN 'CUSTOMER_CLASSIFICATION' THEN 'New customer awaiting approval' ELSE 'New product code awaiting mapping' END,
       NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, s.subject, 'Accept or edit the AI suggestion in step 3 PID enrichment'
FROM ai_assist.suggestions s WHERE s.status = 'PROPOSED' AND s.suggestion_type IN ('CUSTOMER_CLASSIFICATION', 'PRODUCT_MAPPING') AND s.as_of_date <= CAST(:as_of AS DATE)
  AND s.subject_key NOT IN (SELECT customer_id FROM reference.customer_master_approvals)
  AND s.subject_key NOT IN (SELECT source_product_code FROM reference.source_product_map_approvals)

datasets.name: x_kpi
datasets.displayName: Validation - result of the day
queryLines:
WITH v AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS checks, COUNT_IF(status IN ('PASS', 'NOT_APPLICABLE')) AS passed, COUNT_IF(status = 'FAIL') AS failed
           FROM reg_2052a.gold_validation WHERE as_of_date = CAST(:as_of AS DATE)),
items AS (SELECT DISTINCT d.rule_id, COALESCE(d.record_key, NULLIF(REGEXP_EXTRACT(d.failure_detail, '([A-Z]{3}-[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}-[A-Z0-9]+#[A-Z0-9]+)', 1), ''),
                      CONCAT(d.table_code, '|', COALESCE(d.product_id, 'None'), '|', SUBSTR(COALESCE(d.failure_detail, ''), 1, 80))) AS item_key
          FROM reg_2052a.gold_validation_detail d JOIN reg_2052a.gold_validation g
            ON g.as_of_date = d.as_of_date AND g.rule_id = d.rule_id AND g.status = 'WARNING' WHERE d.as_of_date = CAST(:as_of AS DATE)),
open AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM items i LEFT ANTI JOIN reg_2052a.validation_decisions x
         ON x.as_of_date = CAST(:as_of AS DATE) AND x.rule_id = i.rule_id AND x.item_key = i.item_key AND x.status <> 'WITHDRAWN'),
f AS (SELECT COUNT_IF(xsd_valid) / COUNT(*) AS xsd_valid FROM reg_2052a.submission_files
      WHERE as_of_date = CAST(:as_of AS DATE) AND run_number = (SELECT MAX(run_number) FROM reg_2052a.submission_files WHERE as_of_date = CAST(:as_of AS DATE)))
SELECT v.passed / v.checks AS passed_pct, v.failed, open.n AS warnings_open, f.xsd_valid FROM v, open, f

datasets.name: x_by_source
datasets.displayName: Validation - checks by source and result
queryLines:
SELECT CASE rule_source WHEN 'Fed PSV' THEN 'Fed post-submission checks' WHEN 'Instructions' THEN 'FR 2052a Instructions'
            WHEN '6G BR' THEN 'Fed 6G business rules' WHEN '6G BR General' THEN 'Fed 6G file rules' WHEN '6G XSD' THEN 'Fed 6G schema (XSD)'
            ELSE rule_source END AS source,
       CASE WHEN status IN ('PASS', 'NOT_APPLICABLE') THEN 'Passed' WHEN status = 'WARNING' THEN 'Warning' ELSE 'Failed' END AS result, COUNT(*) AS checks
FROM reg_2052a.gold_validation WHERE as_of_date = CAST(:as_of AS DATE) GROUP BY ALL

datasets.name: x_issues
datasets.displayName: Validation - checks not passing today and where each stands
queryLines:
WITH items AS (SELECT DISTINCT d.rule_id, COALESCE(d.record_key, NULLIF(REGEXP_EXTRACT(d.failure_detail, '([A-Z]{3}-[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}-[A-Z0-9]+#[A-Z0-9]+)', 1), ''),
                      CONCAT(d.table_code, '|', COALESCE(d.product_id, 'None'), '|', SUBSTR(COALESCE(d.failure_detail, ''), 1, 80))) AS item_key FROM reg_2052a.gold_validation_detail d WHERE d.as_of_date = CAST(:as_of AS DATE)),
st AS (SELECT i.rule_id, COUNT(*) AS exceptions, COUNT(x.item_key) AS resolved
       FROM items i LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT rule_id, item_key FROM reg_2052a.validation_decisions WHERE as_of_date = CAST(:as_of AS DATE) AND status <> 'WITHDRAWN') x
         USING (rule_id, item_key) GROUP BY 1)
SELECT v.rule_id, v.rule_name, v.rule_source, v.severity, CASE v.status WHEN 'FAIL' THEN 'Failed' ELSE 'Warning' END AS result,
       COALESCE(st.exceptions, v.records_failed) AS exceptions, COALESCE(st.resolved, 0) AS resolved,
       COALESCE(st.exceptions, v.records_failed) - COALESCE(st.resolved, 0) AS still_open,
       CASE WHEN COALESCE(st.exceptions, v.records_failed) - COALESCE(st.resolved, 0) = 0 THEN 'Resolved - nothing to do'
            WHEN v.status = 'FAIL' THEN 'Blocks the filing - correct in step 4 Validate' ELSE 'Explain or fix in step 4 Validate' END AS action
FROM reg_2052a.gold_validation v LEFT JOIN st USING (rule_id)
WHERE v.as_of_date = CAST(:as_of AS DATE) AND v.status IN ('FAIL', 'WARNING') ORDER BY v.status, still_open DESC

datasets.name: p_tables
datasets.displayName: Report - tables
queryLines:
SELECT t.section, v.table_code, t.table_name, COUNT(*) AS records, SUM(v.record_count) AS positions,
       SUM(CASE WHEN v.product_id IN ('S.L.6', 'S.L.10') THEN 0 ELSE v.reported_amount_usd END) AS usd_mm
FROM reg_2052a.v_filing_records v JOIN reference.spec_tables t USING (table_code)
WHERE v.as_of_date = CAST(:as_of AS DATE) AND v.reporting_entity = :entity GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY v.table_code

datasets.name: p_records
datasets.displayName: Report - reported records
queryLines:
SELECT t.section, v.table_code, v.product_id, pr.product_name, COALESCE(v.sub_product, '') AS sub_product, COALESCE(v.counterparty, '') AS counterparty,
       COALESCE(v.collateral_class, '') AS collateral_class, v.maturity_bucket, v.currency,
       v.converted, v.reported_amount, v.reported_amount_usd, v.record_count AS positions, v.validation_status, v.record_key
FROM reg_2052a.v_filing_records v JOIN reference.spec_tables t USING (table_code)
LEFT JOIN reference.ref_product pr ON pr.product_id = v.product_id
WHERE v.as_of_date = CAST(:as_of AS DATE) AND v.reporting_entity = :entity ORDER BY v.table_code, v.product_id, v.reported_amount_usd DESC

datasets.name: p_positions
datasets.displayName: Report - positions behind each record
queryLines:
SELECT t.section, l.table_code, p.product_id, l.record_key, l.position_id, p.record_id, p.source_system, p.source_product_code, p.booking_entity,
       COALESCE(p.customer_id, '') AS customer_id, COALESCE(p.counterparty, '') AS counterparty, COALESCE(p.collateral_class, '') AS collateral_class,
       p.maturity_date, p.maturity_bucket, p.currency, l.amount, p.pid_rule_id
FROM reg_2052a.record_lineage l JOIN reference.spec_tables t USING (table_code)
JOIN conformed.fact_liquidity_position p ON p.as_of_date = l.as_of_date AND p.position_id = l.position_id
WHERE l.as_of_date = CAST(:as_of AS DATE) AND l.reporting_entity = :entity ORDER BY l.table_code, p.product_id, l.record_key

datasets.name: a_log
datasets.displayName: Adjustments - audit trail
queryLines:
SELECT as_of_date, adjustment_type, subject, COALESCE(field, '') AS field, COALESCE(old_value, '') AS old_value, COALESCE(new_value, '') AS new_value,
       COALESCE(note, '') AS note, made_by, made_at, status FROM (
  SELECT as_of_date, 'Data quality fix' AS adjustment_type, record_id AS subject,
         CASE field WHEN '_map_code' THEN 'product code mapped' WHEN '_exclude' THEN 'record excluded' ELSE field END AS field,
         old_value, new_value, reason AS note, preparer AS made_by, created_at AS made_at, status FROM dq.record_fixes
  UNION ALL SELECT as_of_date, 'Position correction', position_id, field, old_value, new_value, reason, preparer, created_at, status FROM reg_2052a.position_corrections
  UNION ALL SELECT as_of_date, 'Reported amount adjustment', record_key, column_name, NULL, CAST(amount AS STRING), reason, preparer, created_at, status FROM reg_2052a.adjustments
  UNION ALL SELECT approved_on, 'New customer approved', customer_id, 'counterparty', NULL, counterparty, customer_name, approved_by, decided_at, 'APPROVED' FROM reference.customer_master_approvals
  UNION ALL SELECT approved_on, 'New product code mapped', source_product_code, 'standard product type', NULL, standard_product_type, description, approved_by, decided_at, 'APPROVED'
            FROM reference.source_product_map_approvals
  UNION ALL SELECT as_of_date, CASE WHEN suggestion_type IN ('COMMENT_DRAFT', 'VARIANCE_COMMENTARY') THEN 'Comment for the Fed' ELSE 'PID exception' END,
            subject_key, LOWER(REPLACE(suggestion_type, '_', ' ')), NULL, NULL, subject, decided_by, decided_at, status
            FROM ai_assist.suggestions WHERE status <> 'PROPOSED' AND suggestion_type IN ('COMMENT_DRAFT', 'VARIANCE_COMMENTARY', 'PID_EXCEPTION')
  UNION ALL SELECT as_of_date, CASE WHEN action = 'explain' THEN 'Validation exception explained' ELSE 'Validation exception corrected' END,
            item_key, rule_id, NULL, NULL, note, decided_by, decided_at, status FROM reg_2052a.validation_decisions
  UNION ALL SELECT as_of_date, 'Sign-off', CONCAT('run ', run_number, ' v', version), LOWER(REPLACE(action, '_', ' ')), NULL, status, note, actor, action_timestamp, status
            FROM reg_2052a.submission_review WHERE action <> 'GENERATED')
WHERE as_of_date = CAST(:as_of AS DATE) ORDER BY made_at DESC

lines:
## Source to Report

Pick a day and a source feed: the exact records it sent, which passed the data quality check, the positions they became after enrichment, how each reporting entity reports them, and the FR 2052a records they end up in.
### 1. Source records - exactly as the source system sent them

frame.title: Every record of the feed, every field, with the file it arrived in and when it was received

lines: ### 2. Data quality check - which records passed, which were held back and by which rule
### 3. Enriched positions - each record split into its FR 2052a parts (e.g. insured / uninsured), with counterparty, collateral, maturity and its FR 2052a product (PID)
### 4. Positions by reporting entity - each position in every reporting entity that owns the booking entity (consolidated, bank, broker-dealer)
### 5. Reported FR 2052a records - positions with the same reporting fields are added up into one record of the 6G file

frame.title: FR 2052a records containing this feed's positions
frame.description: A record can also hold positions from other feeds; paste its record key in the app's Lineage page to trace it.

lines:
## Data quality

Do I have all the data, and is it right? Completeness: every source feed and record received. Accuracy: every record passes the data quality rules and the filing ties to the general ledger and the LCR (BCBS 239 principles 3 and 4).

lines:
## Rule coverage and validation

Did every record get its FR 2052a product (PID) from a rule, and did today's report pass every check - the FR 2052a Instructions, the Fed's 6G business rules and schema, the Fed's post-submission checks and the reconciliations?
### Rule coverage - what has no rule (a new product code, a customer not classified yet, a combination no rule covers) and what to do

## FR 2052a tables

The report as the Federal Reserve prescribes it: Inflows, Outflows and Supplemental, each table, product (PID) and reported record, down to the positions behind it. Narrow it with the filters.

lines:
## Adjustments

Every change made in the app for the day - what changed, from and to, why, by whom and when - as of the last pipeline run (changes made since then are in the app, and appear here after the next run).
